item.title: 6月12日のニュース：US Military Launches Additional Strikes on Iran, Iran Announces Blockade of Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
Japan in English — 日本のニュースを英語で。今日のトップニュースを英語学習者向けにお届けします。
1. US Military Launches Additional Strikes on Iran, Iran Announces Blockade of Strait of Hormuz 2. Sagrada Família's Main Tower Completed, Pope Attends Ceremony 3. Driver Admits to Watching TikTok During Fatal Highway Crash That Killed Six 4. Japanese Diet Agrees on Imperial Succession Measures Including Female Royal Retention 5. PM Kōichi's Secretary Unable to Confirm Voice in Alleged Defamatory Video Scandal
英語スクリプト全文・重要単語の解説はプレミアム（noteメンバーシップ）で公開中。
